description: Twenty document-ingestion fixtures labeled with ideal director-agent slot extraction outputs. This dataset is scoped to extraction accuracy only: slot status, slot value correctness, and slot precision for uploaded or pasted business documents.
notes: Each task uses extracted document text in turns[] so the direct extraction harness can reuse the chat fixture runner.
The source document shape is intentionally varied: SOPs, tables, RACI snippets, audit notes, policies, incident summaries, runbooks, and spreadsheet exports.
expected.slotValues are grader-friendly checks against JSON.stringify(slot_states.value), case-insensitive and alias-aware.
perfectOutput.slot_updates is the human-readable reference answer for the ideal extraction.
Values use director-layer slot paths from lib/interview/director/slot-schema.ts.

tasks.description: Board appendix paragraph with process scope, volume, owner, systems, KPI, and executive priority.
turns:
QBR Appendix: Renewal Operations
Renewal Review starts 120 days before contract expiration and ends when the renewal opportunity is closed-won or escalated to churn save. Revenue Operations owns the workflow; Customer Success Managers provide risk notes. Salesforce is the system of record and Gainsight stores health scores. We process about 300 renewals per quarter. KPI: gross revenue retention. FY priority: reduce late renewal starts by 40%.

value.boundaries: 120 days before contract expiration to closed-won or churn save escalation

tasks.description: Operations SOP with process, owner, volume, systems, dependencies, and variants.
turns:
Warehouse Return Authorization SOP
The RMA process begins when a customer submits a return request and ends when the replacement shipment or credit memo is issued. Customer Support owns intake; Warehouse Ops inspects returned goods; Finance issues credit memos. Zendesk holds the ticket, NetSuite records the credit memo, and ShipStation prints labels. Average volume is 220 RMAs per week. Variant: hazardous-material returns require EHS approval before a label is generated.

value.boundaries: customer return request to replacement shipment or credit memo

variants: Hazardous-material returns require EHS approval before label generation
